question: By what sequence of remembrance and reverence is the sun deity to be dismissed?
premises: The worshipper first remembers the deity.
The worshipper then performs a bow of reverence.
The sun deity is released at the boundary of the mandala.
inference: Remembrance and reverent bowing precede the formal dismissal of the sun deity.
plain_english: Having remembered and bowed, one should release the sun at the edge of the mandala.
